name: exposes
description: The CLI command sends this command or asks this query.

name: honors
description: The runtime package's promise follows the standard rule, so the rule is designed by that contract.

name: honors
description: The code the output contract promises follows the standard rule, so the rule is designed by that contract.

name: implements
description: The generator file emits the code that keeps the contract.

name: keeps
description: The file holds the code that keeps the contract.

name: listed_in
description: The Registry aggregate lists the component: the component is one part of the registry's catalog, so a use case that reaches the registry reaches it.

name: listed_in
description: The Registry aggregate lists the runtime package: the package is released with the common registry and pinned by the archetype, so a use case that reaches the registry reaches it.

name: measured_by
description: The CLI command's output is the measure: it computes the outcome's measure from the product's own records, through the query it exposes.

name: owes
description: The component renders the shared code this contract governs, although another component owns the contract.

name: proves
description: The test proves the library contract.

name: proves
description: The test proves its parent contract.

name: takes_over
description: The package holds the code the component's generator emitted the same way into every service; after the move the component emits only wiring and what varies with the declaration.
